sahneler.metin: The Soviet Moon rocket N1 failed on every launch.
One exploded just after lift-off and destroyed its own launch pad.
Its first stage used thirty engines.
They were never fired together on the ground before flight.
When one failed, problems cascaded through the cluster.
The control system shut down engines it shouldn't have.
After four failures, the programme stopped.
The Soviet crewed lunar landing was cancelled.

aciklama:
N1 rocket failed in all four launch attempts. The cause: complex clustered engines and control system without full ground testing of the first stage.
